title: Feed

Based on the short story by award winning horror author Ty Schwamberger.

description: The story of the greatest explorer of the Americas. At the turn of the 19th century, Alexander von Humboldt began a 5-year scientific expedition to the New World. Traveling over dangerous waters, dry deserts, and treacherous mountains, Humboldt documented the environment, geography and cultures. Humboldt changed our understanding of nature and was the first person to write about climate change.

description: Destined to be among the great jazz virtuosos, Thomas Chapin was nearing the pinnacle of his career when leukemia took him at the age of 40. Decades later, his passionate life and music continue to inspire new generations of musicians.

description: A skateboarder investigating the mysterious death of his roommate is led into the inner workings of a self-help company, and the pharmaceutical lab behind it.

description: After Russia's invasion, Ukrainians arrive in Canada under temporary programs, rebuilding their lives while facing uncertainty and no guaranteed path to permanent residency.

title: Of the Land

However, their excitement doesn't last very long. Strange people are on board with them and out of sudden they try to hijack the plane. In the moment of emergency, an unexpected hero appears to save the plane. Will her dreamlike vacation come true?

title: Old Cats
description: Isidora tries to hide her mind gone so her daughter does not put her in an asylum.

title: Ominous
description: When the Callahans set off for a peaceful family vacation in the mountains they never expected their personal demons to follow them. The children discover a paranormal presence in the secluded cabin and two generations of secrets are revealed, forever changing the lives of the living as well as the dead.

On foot, on horseback or in a wheelchair, but all with an extraordinary determination...

Red Dutton the fiery red head from the Canadian wheat belt moved the team in name and spirit to Brooklyn in a heroic quest to save the Amerks!

But, there's one problem - Zooey and Flip can't catch any fish. Centuries later, marine archaeologist Timmy Gambin leads a 2023 expedition to uncover a 16th‑century shipwreck. Through this discovery, the film explores the hidden history of Mediterranean piracy and slavery, revealing how they were exploited as tools of power, wealth, and political influence across the region.

description: A young woman with Down syndrome refuses to be defined by disability and takes control of her own life. Her ambition to become a motor mechanic.

description: Join a struggling writer battling a bureaucratic system after losing his health plan. Can he overcome obstacles and afford life-saving medication in this era of sort-of universal care?

description: Stranded in London, an amnesiac man named Peter (Luc Merenda) navigates twists and turns of crime and intrigue in this underrated 1970s giallo.

description: After a tragedy strikes during a hunting trip, Andrey will do anything to cover it up--even if it means going after his friends. Quagmire, the chilling debut from Yakutian director Stepan Burnashev, dives deep into guilt, fear, and survival.

description: One million dollar prize money and instant celebrity are at stake but when their reality TV show is shut down, the contestants will have to deal with a world in the grip of a Pandemic.

description: A successful lawyer jeopardizes her career and threatens to tear her family apart after engaging in an affair with her teenage stepson.

description: A suicidal teen develops a rapport with the student from Shanghai assigned to watch her in the hospital. A nightly exchange of secrets, text messages, and possessions expands the boundaries of the relationship and alters inner chemistry.

description: In 1970s Britain, a man drives from London to Bristol to investigate his brother's death, and the purpose of his trip is offset by his encounters with a series of odd people.

description: Watch as superstar rappers get pulled over and arrested by Police. See rap superstars in real life Dramatic confrontations with the law.

description: Photographer Richard Billingham returns to the squalid council flat outside of Birmingham where he and his brother were raised, in a confrontation and reconciliation with parents Ray and Liz.

description: An arctic expedition unearths frozen prehistoric piranhas. Transported for research, a plane crash releases the thawed fish, unleashing terror on vacationers at a resort lake.

description: Approaching 30 years working in the barber shop he inherited from his parents, Raúl starts to change his daily routine, in order to have something new to tell to his customers.

description: What begins as an annual visit to their family grave-site quickly becomes a night of sheer terror as two brothers are unexpectedly forced to fight back against a sudden onslaught of violent assailants.

description: Soo-jin, a woman suffering from post-traumatic memory loss, returns to her daily life with her loving husband. But her recovery takes an unexpected turn when she starts experiencing eerie visions: A child living being hit by a car, then a girl being harassed by a man. She runs into her former boss and learns that her husband may not be telling the truth about everything.

description: The eve of the 2020 election, a posse of progressives ride into red country armed with heart, humor, and naiveté. They should have brought heavy artillery

description: The most sensational 'media crime' investigation of history has started. In RE-EVOLUTION the flashbacks and the interrogatories weave, challenging the audience to rebuild the story of four suspects accused of having freed humanity.

title: Remember?
description: A love story told through the memories of two nameless lovers in different stages of their lives.

title: Remnants
description: Remnants follows three post-apocalyptic survivors as they trek north in search of a safer life.

title: ReSet
description: A college student passes out at a party and wakes in the bedroom of Edgar, who seems nice but has sinister intentions. As she tries to escape, she finds an heirloom that may help her gain the upper hand against her captor.

description: 1809, France. Captain Neuville is called to the front, leaving his future bride heartbroken. Her sister decides to write letters on his behalf to cheer her up. But it all goes south when Neuville reappears.

title: Return to Zero
description: A couple navigate their way through a pregnancy filled with doubt, grief and trepidation.

title: Rez Metal
description: REZ METAL follows the Navajo heavy metal band I Don't Konform's remarkable journey from performing on poverty-stricken reservations to recording their debut album with Grammy-award winner producer of Metallica while telling the compelling story of thriving heavy metal scene on the Navajo reservations.

description: Colm, mid-40s has a comfortable life: a managerial job in Dublin's docks, two teenage children, and a kind, loyal wife in Claire. After the death of his father, a destructive figure, Colm's emotional life cracks open, and his downward spiral continues when he is made redundant. Now, as a cop in a corrupt department, she strives to make sure the rough streets she left behind aren't forgotten. One case leads her to the discovery that No Man's Land is a battleground between angels and demons, a supernatural war that's been waged for centuries. She is thrown into a world she never believed could exist and told that she's the only chance of defeating evil.

description: Experience an electrifying and inclusive celebration of individuality at Copacabana, one of the world's top gay destinations. Join the vibrant gathering of diverse people embracing their sexy bodies.

description: Damien, a London cop with a dark past, must decide: his old crew or protecting a burning, rioting London? Brace yourself for a punch-packed film!

description: Five teens fight for survival in a cannibal-infested mountain town after getting stranded. Thrilling horror awaits.

description: In a fight against the wicked Sheriff of Nottingham, Robin Hood and his loyal outlaws embark on a daring mission to rescue his true love from captivity.

description: Things go horribly wrong when Catherine and Rebecca, two Catholic schoolgirls, knock on the wrong door while selling religious paraphernalia.

On the same day he's hired for a shakedown of a shyster, Ryan learns that his violent brother, CARTER CARSON, has been released from prison and intends to ravage the one woman Ryan loves: his brother's wife, AMORA VEGA. Now on full offensive, aided by anger issues and lively sidekicks, Ryan begins his mission of setting things right at any cost.

That is, until the day he's paired with a very unlikely partner... his mom! Deb Defrates is not a spy. She knows more about cutting coupons then cutting down on crime, but her wisdom and kindness somehow always seem to save the day.

Rânia's best friend, Zizi, introduces her to 'Sereia da Noite', a local joint where fun, dance, money and sex rock the night. When Rânia meets the choreographer Estela, she will be torn between the possibility to make money in the nightclub and the will to become a "real dancer".

description: Various lives converge on an isolated island, all connected by an author whose novel has become inextricably entwined with his own life.

description: David, a sensitive, creative teenager, lives in Southern Israel with his ill mother, his father who gave up his dreams, and his young brother. He discovers an online writing forum and starts publishing his family stories under the fake identity of the rich kid "Nadav". As he gets entangled in his lies, he is afraid of losing his new forum friends, and being exposed by his family. The situation undermines the delicate fabric of the family.

description: Mountain delivers a rocking performance at the Mystic Theatre.

A journey where a strong friendship will unite the children and help them grow with the help of Rimando, a wandering poet, who will help them reach the sea.

This psychological thriller explores the dark territory where love transforms into deadly obsession.

When illness threatens all he holds dear, Toby’s devotion proves that being “real” comes from the heart.

Between jagged moments of unexpected violence, their inexplicable passion carries them further into the abyss of an emotional whirlpool.

description: In front of the waves of the Panamanian Pacific in the town of El Higo, a woman walks and tells the story lived by the Panamanian Tito Arias and Margot Fonteyn, the most acclaimed dancer in the world and incomparable ballet figure.

Under the advice of her mother, Flavia gives her husband an ultimatum to solve his situation. The crisis between them causes Rafael to return to his neighborhood, where he meets old friends from the past who offer him to return to his previous life as a drug dealer, which will unleash a spiral of deception and violence.

description: When two women with dark secrets cross paths, they soon find they're more alike than they were counting on.

This is a meticulous, brave investigative journey that takes Irons (and us) from skepticism to sorrow and from horror to hope.

When lust, lies and deceit mingle, Two Wrongs have never made anything right.

One day Karina arrives in Surinam too.
